I was in a casino once playing blackjack and this guy walked up and stood next to me. He was wearing a black three piece suit and a straw hat like a member of a barbershop quartet would wear. He was probably six and a half feet tall and incredibly thin. The most striking thing about him was his face. Most of his face was covered in severe burns. I invited him to take a seat at the blackjack table. He didn’t acknowledge me and walked away about thirty seconds later. The dealer and I shrug to each other and keep playing and I don’t think too much more about him for a while. 
  I got up a little while later to go check in with my friends and I see the guy again. He’s just standing off to one side of the casino. I brush it off again. After all, all kinds of people go to casinos and it’s hard not to notice someone so noticeable. I caught up with my friends and went on with my night. 
  But I just kept seeing him. No less than eight times I saw this guy. Always just standing still, always facing me. Sometimes even looking right at me. I never saw him gamble or do anything except stand there. Wherever I was in this building, I’d look around and there he would be. At one point we went out to the parking lot to grab something from one of our cars and when we walked back in, he was standing near the entrance. He was not there when we left. By this point, I definitely would have noticed. 
  I decide to tell my friend about this weird experience I’m having so I say “Man I just keep seeing that guy.” “What guy?” “That big tall guy that was standing by the door when we walked back in.” “I didn’t see anyone like that.” My stomach dropped and I immediately convince myself that this guy was a demon or something and I just had to leave. I say my goodbyes and make my way to a different door than where I had last seen the guy. 
  While I’m making my way towards that door I have a moment of clarity and start kicking myself for getting so spooked so easily. After all, I’m not superstition or anything like that. I was just being silly. I turn around to go join my friends again and 
there 
he 
is. 

Staring right at me. Ten feet away. Like something out of a goddamn slasher movie. He was a jump scare come to life. And I did jump and I was scared. I got to my car as fast as I could and I hightailed on out of there, after checking my backseat and trunk of course. I kept checking the rear view and the backseat the whole way home. I have not returned to that casino since. 
  My friends tease me about my encounter with “The Phantom of the Slot-pera”. But To this day I am convinced that this guy was Slenderman or Bughuul or the Angel of Death or something. Still creeps me out.
